subject: Acceptance locklist & MAP gates: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention
content:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@ledgerbank.com>; Tom Berenson <tom.berenson@ledgerbank.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, irene.cho@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acceptance locklist & MAP gates: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention

Hi Elaine / Tom —

Thanks again for the meeting earlier. Per our MAP conversation, LedgerBank asked for a compact acceptance "locklist" that the security team can sign off on before we flip the production switch. I put together a working list below and attached the supporting artifacts. Can you confirm the items that are mandatory for go/no-go on your side (red items) and the items that can be post-close deliverables (amber items)?

Acceptance locklist (proposed)
- SOC 2: latest SOC 2 Type II report and control evidence index (red)
- SIG/CAIQ: completed SIG/CAIQ questions + redline Q&A for any compensating controls (red)
- DPA: DPA signed with EU data residency and subprocessor list attached (red)
- Data retention: retention matrix for PII and transaction logs; proposed retention tiers (amber)
- Endpoint encryption key management: KMS integration summary and audit logs access (red)
- Incident response SLA and contact list (amber)

Attachments included with this thread: SOC2_evidence_index.pdf, SIG_CAIC_answers_v1.xlsx, DPA_redline_20261208.docx, data_retention_matrix.csv

Next steps I suggest:
1) LedgerBank to mark required items red/amber (reply inline) by EOD Wed 12/09
2) Redwood to deliver any additional evidence flagged red by Fri 12/11
3) Legal teams to finalize DPA redlines by 12/15 (DocuSign window)
4) Final go/no-go decision at 12/18 executive alignment call

If that timeline looks tight on your end, call out which milestones you need to slide.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0142


---- Reply from Elaine (external) ----
From: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@ledgerbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Berenson <tom.berenson@ledgerbank.com>, procure@ledgerbank.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance locklist & MAP gates: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick responses inline:
- SOC 2: red — Type II report + control index are required before we enable production keys.
- SIG/CAIQ: red — completed questionnaire must be in our portal; any answers marked "partial" require compensating control notes.
- DPA: red — legal will need the redline; procurement needs confirmation of EU data residency controls.
- Data retention: amber — acceptable to ship with retention matrix, but final retention policy must be documented within 30 days post-close.
- KMS: red — we need KMS integration runbook and at-rest encryption verification.
- Incident response SLA: amber — needed in writing but can be post-close if we have a 24/7 on-call contact now.

I'll loop in Tom from Legal to prioritize DPA redlines. Procurement will confirm on residency. We can target your 12/18 decision meeting.

Elaine
Elaine Cho | Dir., Cloud Risk & Compliance
LedgerBank


---- Reply from Tom (external legal) ----
From: Tom Berenson <tom.berenson@ledgerbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: elaine.cho@ledgerbank.com, proc​ure@ledgerbank.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance locklist & MAP gates: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention

Marcus / Laura —

We reviewed the DPA redline. There are three carveouts we want clarified: 1) EU data residency clause scope (what constitutes "processed in EU"); 2) Subprocessor notification window (we prefer 30 days notice, your draft had 60); 3) Audit clause: we need to preserve audit rights with a neutral third-party option. Please confirm if Redwood can accept those items or propose alternatives.

Tom Berenson | Senior Counsel
LedgerBank Legal


---- Internal note from Laura Bennett ----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, irene.cho@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Acceptance locklist & MAP gates: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention

Team —

Quick status and asks before I reply to Tom:
- EU residency: our Private (VPC) deployment supports EU-only routing; need infra note from InfraOps to include in response (Irene, can you confirm region routing and where logs persist?).
- Subprocessor notice: legal prefers 60 days for operational reasons; propose we accept 30 with quarterly digest of changes to make procurement comfortable.
- Audit clause: we can accept neutral third-party audits for perimeter controls; for production access logs we will propose a SOC2+ supplemental review with AuditWorks.

Irene: could you attach a short export that shows retention buckets and physical region of logs? Neha: please pull the KMS integration verification that shows key rotation and who has access. I'll assemble a DPA response draft by EOD that addresses Tom's three carveouts.

Thanks —Laura
Laura Bennett | Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference


---- Internal reply from Irene Choi (InfraOps) ----
From: Irene Choi <irene.cho@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Acceptance locklist & MAP gates: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention

Laura / Marcus —

Attached: data_retention_matrix.csv (stub) — export shows three retention tiers: 
- Tier A (PII, transaction metadata): stored in region EU-1 for EU accounts, retention default 90 days, configurable per-customer
- Tier B (logs, telemetry): retained 365 days, archived after 90 days to cold storage (EU or US per account)
- Tier C (aggregates): 24 months

KMS notes (refer to SOC2_evidence_index.pdf): customer-managed keys supported via external KMS integration; rotation every 90 days; logs of key usage available to customers via audit stream. We can include the KMS runbook as an artifact if LedgerBank wants it.

Irene
Irene Choi | Sr. Infra Engineer, Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: data_retention_matrix.csv, SOC2_evidence_index.pdf


---- Final summary from Marcus (thread closure) ----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@ledgerbank.com>, Tom Berenson <tom.berenson@ledgerbank.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, irene.cho@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, procure@ledgerbank.com
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance locklist & MAP gates: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA / retention

Thanks all — appreciate the quick clarifications.

Summary & agreed actions:
- LedgerBank marks SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA, and KMS verification as red (blockers) — LedgerBank to confirm by EOD Fri 12/10 if any further detail is required.
- Redwood to provide: SOC2_evidence_index.pdf (attached), KMS runbook + rotation logs (Irene to attach), and SIG/CAIQ completed spreadsheet (attached). Delivered by Fri 12/11.
- Laura will propose DPA compromises: accept neutral third-party audit for perimeter controls; propose 30-day subprocessor notice with quarterly digest; confirm EU residency language to match Private deployment routing. Draft sent to Tom by 12/11.
- Final decision meeting: Thurs 12/18 10:00am PT — executive alignment call (we'll send calendar invite via HubSpot / Calendar link). If any red item is still outstanding on 12/17 close of business, LedgerBank reserves right to delay production enablement.

I attached the working MAP artifacts to this thread for ledger review. If you'd like a short 30-min follow-up to go through the evidence pack we can set that for tomorrow.

Regards,

Marcus

Attachments referenced in thread (stubs): SOC2_evidence_index.pdf; SIG_CAIC_answers_v1.xlsx; DPA_redline_20261208.docx; data_retention_matrix.csv
